limitations: One shared Windows consumer GPU; no CXL/DSA hardware or exclusive physical residency guarantee.
Independent processes share one machine/session; no external replication or unbiased population estimate.
Small public corpus and bounded continuations are not broad language quality evaluation.
Native reference is precision matched; passing low-precision bounds does not establish equivalence to FP32.

model.loader: builtin Transformers, local safetensors only, trust_remote_code=False

uncertainty_unit: independent worker process, not adjacent tokens

dataset.attribution: WikiText by Stephen Merity et al.; source text from Wikipedia. See https://huggingface.co/datasets/Salesforce/wikitext

input.scope: Contiguous public text; finite continuation NLL only, not a downstream task suite

protocol.comparison: Matched dtype native SDPA; same corpus history in separate validation replay
protocol.timing: Full free greedy generation: prefill, token selection, input preparation, append/eviction/transfers, synchronized forwards. Validation is a separate replay.
protocol.prefill_logits: Final token only for all arms
protocol.precision: FP16/BF16 KV storage, FP32 partition math; conversion costs included. Native SDPA uses matched model dtype.
protocol.quality: Real next-token NLL and distribution diagnostics over a bounded continuation; no general quality or training claim
protocol.memory: Allocator peaks, process RSS, board observations; Windows WDDM may spill. No hard quota or CXL hardware.
